" ADB Call Commands:

1. Start Mock Service
adb shell am broadcast -a fl.mock.start -e key [API Key]

2. Set Mock Location
adb shell am broadcast -a fl.mock.set -e key [API Key] -e lat [Latitude] -e lng [Longitude]

3. Stop Mock Service
adb shell am broadcast -a fl.mock.stop -e key [API Key]

Tips:
• Please ensure ADB tool is installed on your computer, and USB Debugging is enabled in Developer Options on your phone.
• Example: adb shell am broadcast -a fl.mock.set -e key 1234 -e lat 39.9 -e lng 116.3 "

"To implement Mock Location (NOROOT mode), you must allow Fake Location to proxy the system location services.
Please note: 1. Proxying the system location service will affect the device location data obtained by the system and its applications, and may even affect their normal operation! 2. To cancel the service proxy, you must Stop Mock or Restart device.
Please confirm whether to allow Fake Location to proxy the system location service? "

"To implement Mock Location (ROOT mode), you must allow Fake Location to proxy the system location services (including GPS, base station search, and Wi-Fi search services), and set SELinux to Permissive mode.
Please note: 1. Proxying the system location service will affect the device location data obtained by the system and its applications, and may even affect their normal operation! 2. Setting SELinux to Permissive mode will reduce system security! 3. To cancel service proxying or restore SELinux, you must Stop Mock or Reboot device.
Please confirm whether to allow Fake Location to proxy the system location service and set SELinux to Permissive mode? "

"To implement Mock WiFi, you must allow Fake Location to proxy the system Wi-Fi service and set SELinux to Permissive mode.
Please note: 1. Proxying the system Wi-Fi service will affect the system and its applications access to the device's connected and nearby Wi-Fi data, potentially affecting their normal operation! 2. Setting SELinux to Permissive mode will reduce system security! 3. To cancel service proxying or restore SELinux, you must Stop Mock or Restart device.
Please confirm whether you allow Fake Location to proxy the system Wi-Fi service and set SELinux to Permissive mode. "
